description: This file defines the AccountingProcessorForLoanFactory class which determines the appropriate AccountingProcessorForLoan implementation based on the properties of a LoanDTO object. It uses Spring's ApplicationContext to retrieve bean instances for different accounting processors.

classes.name: AccountingProcessorForLoanFactory
classes.description: A factory class that determines the appropriate AccountingProcessorForLoan implementation based on LoanDTO properties.

methods.name: determineProcessor
methods.description: Decides and returns the suitable AccountingProcessorForLoan implementation bean from the application context based on the type of accounting enabled in LoanDTO.
